goal: Manuscript drafted, every gate PASS, and a build artifact exists (or compile gate SKIPPED in degraded mode).

stories.title: Intake
stories.acceptance: project.md has TITLE, VENUE, TEMPLATE; research/inputs read; assumptions recorded

stories.title: Preflight / bootstrap
stories.acceptance: research/.state/toolkit.md exists and MODE is set; IEEEtran present or degraded mode recorded

stories.title: Research plan
stories.acceptance: plan.md has objectives, RQs, contributions mapped to sections and experiments

stories.title: Literature
stories.acceptance: literature-matrix.md has >=1 verified row per cited work; no CLAIM_UNVERIFIED in the final claim set

stories.title: Methodology
stories.acceptance: sections/methodology.tex written, symbols defined, design decisions justified

stories.title: Experimental design + implementation
stories.acceptance: experiments/design.md specifies baselines, metrics, splits, runs, statistical test

stories.title: Results
stories.acceptance: results.tex values all trace to MEASURED evidence rows

stories.title: Body writing
stories.acceptance: intro, related, discussion, conclusion drafted within word budgets

stories.title: Abstract + keywords + title check
stories.acceptance: bash scripts/audit-tex.sh --words passes and abstract is 150-250 words

stories.title: Figures + tables
stories.acceptance: every float referenced; captions below figures, titles above tables

stories.title: References
stories.acceptance: bash scripts/audit-tex.sh --citations resolves every cite key

stories.title: Humanizer + style + consistency
stories.acceptance: numbers diff empty; language and consistency gates PASS

stories.title: Compile
stories.acceptance: bash scripts/build-pdf.sh exits 0 with BUILD: PASS, or BUILD: SKIPPED in degraded mode
